label: second copy step (re-input of first token) in long (L>=8) sequences, esp. first token u/v/e/p
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase at step L+1 (recall_idx==1, input = fed-back first original token, prev_tok=<DEL>), almost entirely for L=9 (89% of mass) or L=8 (10%); never in original or delimiter phases, nor at other copy positions except a few recall_idx==2. Context (recall_idx==1 & L>=8) covers 98% of mass but has only ~1% precision: the unit is a sparse tail firing on ~2% of such steps. Magnitude/likelihood is strongly modulated by the first token: u (12x lift, 46% of mass), then v, e, p; top activations are mostly u-initial sequences, often with w among the later original tokens. Restricting to u/v/e/p gives dev F1 0.11, mass recall 0.77; remaining selectivity not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (+4.27), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+3.04), orig4=w (+2.81), phase=2 & in_tok=v (+2.72), orig3=w (+2.69), orig0=p (+2.16). Lower it: orig7=- (-2.29), orig8=- (-1.63), next_out=- (-1.61), orig5=j (-1.41).
